name: Unitas Orcklespock
description: A Kaiju Blooded farmer curious to learn more about the world and his place in it.
notes: A somewhat devoted follower of the Knight.

name: Sahaero Barman
description: A runaway prince trying to outrun his past and find his lover.

name: Seldorl Barirahl
description: A drow trying to forget his bloodlust and find a new path of peace and justice.
notes: A newly converted paladin of the Queen.

name: Jasper Arkose
description: A paladin who will not stop until he reclaims the throne of Reiwa.

name: Zettai
description: A Kaiju Blooded whose mutations have been stopped for now by the Flesh.

name: Azarn
description: A tiefling who wants revenge on his noble family.

name: Aliban
description: A very curious aasimar who wants to learn more about his lineage and his connection to the Bug.

name: Jet Jaguar
description: A hero of Gojirin who has joined forces with the others to stop the threats that have resurfaced on the island.

name: Ichi
description: A masked warrior of the Dragon and the leader of his three main paladins.

name: Ni
description: A masked warrior of the Dragon and the second of his three main paladins.

name: San
description: A masked warrior of the Dragon and the third of his three main paladins.

name: Baragon
description: A miner from the town of Cupad who became involved in the fate of the island.

name: Gilfred
description: A large centipede who was helped by Aliban and became his pet.

name: The King
description: The leader of the gods, he is a god of respect and honor and is the one who has been keeping the peace between the gods and mortals.

name: The Shield
description: The ruler of Showa, he is a god of protection and is considered a hero by the people of Gojirin.

name: The Queen
description: The partner of the King, she is a goddess of healing and love and is known to be reborn if she is killed.

name: The Phoenix
class: Focus on fire and the sun.
description: The god who lives in the volcano known as Mount Sun, he is the god of fire and the sun. He is known not to bow to any god unless they prove themselves.

name: The Dragon
description: The god of conquest, he wants to rule over all of Gojirin, making everyone else bow to him and him alone.

name: The Flesh
description: The god of flesh, he wants to consume all of Gojirin, making everyone and everything part of him.

name: The Knight
class: Focus on the spirit of fighting and winning.
description: The god of the knightly spirit, he values honor and victory. No battle shall end without a winner.

name: The Bug
class: Focus on the earth itself and the Underdark of Gojirin.
description: The god of the ground, he protects the land and all that dwell within it.

name: The Mech
description: The god of technology, he values progress and improvement. He is known to always be looking for ways to improve the lives of the people of Gojirin.

name: The Monk
description: The god of peace, he values harmony and tranquility. He resides in his temple in the mountains of Reiwa.

name: The Plant
description: The goddess of plants and life, she values animals and the natural world.

name: The Grim Reaper?
description: Unknown.

name: The Crystal
description: The god of fear, he values power and control. He is known to always be looking for ways to instill fear in the people of Heisei to keep them in check.

name: The Devil
description: The god of destruction, he values chaos and anarchy.

name: The Shapeshifter
description: The god of perfection, he is known to take the best qualities of the others and use their strengths upon himself.

name: The Keizer
description: Unknown.

name: The Blizzard
description: The goddess of ice and water who has been missing for centuries. She was once the original ruler of Reiwa.

name: The Forgotten
description: The god of revenge, he values pure anger and getting back at those who have wronged him.

name: Zagreth
description: The leader of the Hedoron cult who hides his face beneath a hood.
